# 2026-05-19 Azure Deployment Pipeline

- Created GitHub Actions workflow for continuous deployment to Azure App Service.
- Supports push to main and manual workflow dispatch.
- Builds, tests, and publishes the ASP.NET Core/Blazor application.
- Supports deployment via publish profile or Azure service principal.
- Includes safeguards for production secrets and ACH submission controls.
- Provides comprehensive deployment documentation and checklists.
